samples.summary: Only one of the editor's raw-`docStore` write sites was moved onto `revocableStore`; the others still write straight through the unrevoked store
samples.evidence: The diff introduces `revocableStore` as "the write handle every store-backed object in this editor is built over" and migrates exactly one call — `guardedSetPageSetup` → `revocableStore.setPageSetup` — calling it "the single page-setup-shaped hole". It is not the only hole: `writePageSetup` at packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2325 still calls `docStore.setPageSetup(resolvePageSetup(setup))` on the RAW store (and it is the path `EditorAPI.setPageSetup` and the ruler margin drag share), `stepSelectionFontSizeImpl` writes `docStore.applyStyles(...)` at editor.ts:1379, and the four named-style entry points write `docStore.setDocStyles` / `updateStyleDefinition` / `resetStyle` / `resetAllStyles` at editor.ts:3576, 3621, 3624, 3627. None of these is revoked by `disposed`. They are unreachable after `dispose()` today only because every api member that reaches them (`setPageSetup`, `stepSelectionFontSize`, `setDocStyles`, `updateStyleToMatch`, `resetNamedStyle`, `resetAllNamedStyles`) happens to be listed in `MUTATING_METHODS`, and because `ruler.dispose()` (packages/docs/src/view/ruler/index.ts:460) unbinds the drag handlers. So the new revocation is load-bearing on a deny-list staying complete — the exact failure mode packages/docs/src/store/read-only.ts:6-19 documents ("a list nobody remembers to extend fails *open*"). Fix belongs on the new code: route these writes through `revocableStore` too.

samples.summary: `revocableDocStore` revokes on property lookup only, so a method reference extracted before disposal keeps writing to the real store
samples.evidence: While live, the `get` trap returns `raw.bind(target)` where `target` is the real store (packages/docs/src/store/read-only.ts:202). A holder that destructured or cached a member — `const { insertText } = editor.getStore()` / `const snap = store.snapshot` — before `disposed` flipped holds a function bound to the underlying store and is never re-checked, which contradicts `EditorAPI.isDisposed`'s claim that the handles go read-only "copies already taken included" (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:411-414). I could not find a current site that extracts a member: every frontend use re-looks it up at call time (`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-find-bar.tsx:67` `() => editor.getStore().snapshot()`, docs-export-button.tsx:53, docs-comments-controller.ts:162/261/381, harness/hunt/bridge.ts:386). So this is a latent hole in the guard rather than a live bypass; a `isRevoked()` check inside the bound wrapper would close it.

samples.summary: Adding `readOnlyMount` to the slides mount effect breaks the "mount effect runs once per doc" assumption the layout-edit effect relies on
samples.evidence: The mount effect now re-runs on a `readOnlyMount` flip (packages/frontend/src/app/slides/slides-view.tsx:1237), rebuilding editor + store. The layout-edit effect is keyed on `[layoutEditTarget, didMount, onLayoutEditTargetChange]` (slides-view.tsx:1295) and drives ENTER/SWITCH/EXIT off `layoutEditStoreRef.current`; on a rebuild while a layout-edit session is open it does not re-run, so the new editor never gets `enterLayoutEditMode(les)` while `layoutEditStoreRef.current` still holds the old proxy and `thumbsHost.style.display` stays hidden — and the later EXIT branch calls `editor.exitLayoutEditMode(...)` on an editor that never entered it. Not reachable today: `readOnly` only changes on `/shared/:token`, and that route mounts `SlidesView` without `layoutEditTarget` (it is passed only from the owner route, packages/frontend/src/app/slides/slides-detail.tsx:522, where `readOnly` is never passed). Flagged because the new dependency is what makes the once-per-doc assumption false.
searchedFor: grep layoutEditTarget in slides-detail.tsx and shared-document.tsx

samples.summary: `setDocument` / `replaceDocument` now clear the redo stack through `willWrite()`, a behaviour change for MemDocStore consumers outside the docs editor
samples.evidence: `willWrite()` unconditionally sets `redoStack = []` (packages/docs/src/store/memory.ts, `willWrite`), and it is now called from `setDocument` and `replaceDocument`, neither of which touched the undo/redo stacks before. Every current MemDocStore `setDocument` caller does it at construction time, when there is no redo to lose — packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1114, packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:435, packages/frontend/src/app/harness/visual/docs-scenarios.tsx:108, packages/frontend/src/app/harness/hunt/page.tsx:503, packages/frontend/src/components/history/revision-preview.tsx:813 — and `replaceDocument` has no production caller at all, so nothing breaks now. Recorded because a host that reloads a document mid-session (the pending-DOCX-import shape in docs-view.tsx:388, on a MemDocStore mount) would silently lose its redo branch.
searchedFor: grep setDocument in text-box-editor.ts and editor.ts

finding.summary: Adding `readOnlyMount` to the slides mount effect breaks the "mount effect runs once per doc" assumption the layout-edit effect relies on
finding.evidence: The mount effect now re-runs on a `readOnlyMount` flip (packages/frontend/src/app/slides/slides-view.tsx:1237), rebuilding editor + store. The layout-edit effect is keyed on `[layoutEditTarget, didMount, onLayoutEditTargetChange]` (slides-view.tsx:1295) and drives ENTER/SWITCH/EXIT off `layoutEditStoreRef.current`; on a rebuild while a layout-edit session is open it does not re-run, so the new editor never gets `enterLayoutEditMode(les)` while `layoutEditStoreRef.current` still holds the old proxy and `thumbsHost.style.display` stays hidden — and the later EXIT branch calls `editor.exitLayoutEditMode(...)` on an editor that never entered it. Not reachable today: `readOnly` only changes on `/shared/:token`, and that route mounts `SlidesView` without `layoutEditTarget` (it is passed only from the owner route, packages/frontend/src/app/slides/slides-detail.tsx:522, where `readOnly` is never passed). Flagged because the new dependency is what makes the once-per-doc assumption false.
searchedFor: grep layoutEditTarget in slides-detail.tsx and shared-document.tsx

verdict.reason: The claimed broken state cannot occur. The mount-effect cleanup at packages/frontend/src/app/slides/slides-view.tsx:1207-1211 explicitly disposes the layout-list panel, sets `layoutEditStoreRef.current = null`, and calls `onLayoutEditTargetChangeRef.current?.(null)` whenever a layout-edit session is live at teardown — so after a rebuild the ref does NOT still hold the old proxy, and the parent is driven out of layout-edit mode. The subsequent `layoutEditTarget -> null` re-render re-runs the layout-edit effect (layoutEditTarget is in its deps, :1295) with both `layoutEditTarget === null` and `layoutEditStoreRef.current === null`, so the EXIT branch (:1283-1293) never calls `editor.exitLayoutEditMode` on the new editor. The "thumbsHost stays hidden" claim is also false: both rail hosts are freshly created DOM nodes each mount-effect run (:338-348), thumbsHost at default display. Separately, the interaction is unreachable: the only site passing layoutEditTarget (slides-detail.tsx:514-524) never passes readOnly (no `readOnly` occurrence in that file, so readOnlyMount at :198 is permanently false), and the only site passing readOnly (shared-document.tsx:557-562) never passes layoutEditTarget. The cross-effect hazard the finding describes is already guarded by the cleanup that predates and accompanies the dep, and the pre-existing `doc` dep already made the "once per doc" framing moot.
